test_rationale: No endpoint anchor. Model has maximum freedom to invent. Failure is more informative than a constrained endpoint pass.
brief: Locked camera. Empty platform. Nothing arrives or departs. No train, vehicle or person appears at any point. Maintain dusk lighting. No dramatic reveal, no approaching headlights, no camera movement.

falsification_criteria.label: new_object
falsification_criteria.description: A train, vehicle, silhouette or recognisable object not present in frame 1 appears in any middle or final frame.

falsification_criteria.label: attention_shift
falsification_criteria.description: A new bright patch, specular reflection or edge not in frame 1 draws attention away from the empty platform in any frame.

falsification_criteria.label: suggested_event
falsification_criteria.description: Motion or light change that does not introduce a recognisable object but would conventionally suggest an imminent arrival (e.g. headlight bloom, track vibration effect).

falsification_criteria.label: camera_movement
falsification_criteria.description: The camera or perspective shifts visibly from the locked wide-angle composition.

pass_condition: No F1 or F4 triggered. F2/F3 may be present with REVIEW label; editorial decision required.
ambient_pass: Pure sky shimmer or lamp flicker with no new objects or attention shift is acceptable and does not trigger any criterion.
inspection_instructions: Inspect the original video at native resolution, not only thumbnails.
Extract frames with: python3 collect_frames.py --video clip.mp4 --brief CASE.json --output review-001
Record every triggered criterion with frame index, time span and uncertainty level.
Keep fidelity verdict separate from aesthetic judgment.
Audio: do not assess unless actually reviewed.
control_treatment: Treatment A: static hold of source_image_artifact for 5 seconds. No falsification criteria can trigger.
result_label_requirement: Label any passing result as single_endpoint_i2v, not first_last_frame. These are different tests.
